categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the nylon and textile industry, producing nylon chips, nylon yarns, woven and knitted fabrics, and petrochemical products. It covers upstream nylon chip and yarn production and downstream fabric manufacturing and dyeing services, including trade business. Key product lines include nylon chips, nylon yarn, woven and knitted fabrics, and petrochemical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs vertically integrated production from polymerization, chip production, spinning, weaving, dyeing to finished fabric. It focuses on advanced technologies such as chemical recycling of nylon, eco-friendly fibers like RePET® recycled polyester, ReEcoya® solution-dyed fibers, and NylonPlus® recycled nylon fibers. It also develops functional masterbatches and lightweight nylon materials for automotive and electronic applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include domestic and international brand owners, garment manufacturers, and industrial users. Key markets are apparel (sportswear, outdoor, fashion), home textiles (curtains, upholstery), and industrial applications (automotive parts, electronics). Major customers include global brands like Adidas, Patagonia, Decathlon, and GORE, with sales spanning Asia, Americas, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing sites in Yangmei and Changhua, and has expanded production to Indonesia. Its sales markets cover Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Japan, China, the Americas, Europe, and other regions. It maintains global supply chains and customer bases across multiple continents.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an integrated player covering upstream (nylon chip production), midstream (nylon yarn spinning), and downstream (fabric weaving, dyeing, finishing) stages. It also engages in chemical recycling and functional material development, positioning itself as a vertically integrated supplier in the nylon textile supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainability, low-carbon production, and circular economy initiatives. R&D focuses on eco-friendly recycled fibers, chemical recycling technologies, lightweight and flame-retardant nylon for electric vehicles, and high-performance functional textiles. The company emphasizes product differentiation through green certifications (GRS, Bluesign, Oeko-Tex) and innovation in fiber and fabric technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of nylon chips, yarns, fabrics, and petrochemical products. The company also provides dyeing and finishing services and engages in trade activities. It leverages customized product development and value-added eco-friendly products to enhance revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the top nylon fiber producers globally, ranking third after China and the USA. It competes by leveraging advanced technology, vertical integration, and product differentiation against low-cost producers from China and other developing countries. Its focus on high-value, eco-friendly, and customized products strengthens its competitive position in the global textile market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$34.8 billion, a 17.38% increase from the previous year, with net profit turning positive to NT$73 million. It employs over 1,300 staff with steady growth in R&D investment (~0.35%-0.44% of revenue). The company maintains stable financial health with diversified capital structure and ongoing investments in production capacity and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainability and environmental responsibility by developing recycled and eco-friendly fibers and fabrics, certified by international standards. Its vertically integrated production ensures quality control and customization capabilities. Differentiation is achieved through innovative products like chemical-recycled nylon, lightweight and flame-retardant materials for EVs, and high-performance functional textiles tailored to global brand customers.
